messages:
santiago: Quick ask — can someone run a lightweight perf profile for cinder-6b-v3 on the int8 pipeline? Need P95 tail, cold-start behavior, and a tiny concurrency sweep (1, 4, 8). aiming to publish a short perf snapshot for docs by EOD.
laura: I can kick this off. which sequence lengths and sample prompts should we use? also want to try both kv-cache enabled/disabled.
bench-bot: Job created: https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/bench/63219
Config: `model=cinder-6b-v3 quant=int8 batch_policy=auto seqs=[32,128,512] conc=[1,4,8] kv_cache=[on,off] samples=20`
evan: Quick heads up — cinder-6b-v3 has a known tiling quirk at seq>256 on newer kernels, might see a small eviction spike. LN: set `tiling_threshold=256` for parity with the canary env.
laura: running now. will post results here when done.
laura: smoke run finished, attaching summary: P50: 32ms @1c  seq32 kv:on, P95: 128ms @4c seq128 kv:on, P95 tail spike at seq512 ~ 430ms (observed jitter). throughput @8c seq128 ~ 95 tok/s. artifact: https://artifacts.redwood/cinder6bv3/63219/snapshot.html
maya: nice — any memory pressure or OOM hints from the workers?
laura: mem looked fine overall, GPU util steady 62%-78%. saw small KV cache eviction bursts at the 2nd token group on seq512 -> correlated to our tiling threshold note.
evan: thanks — suggestion: for hosted rollout, recommend defaulting to kv_cache=on, tiling_threshold=256, and a canary with seq512 disabled for 2 weeks. prob also add a soft-failover to cinder-6b-v2 for tail traffic.
santiago: okay actionable. laura can you paste the minimal reproduce command and add a short note for docs (3 bullets)?
laura: reproduce command:
```
redwood-bench run --model cinder-6b-v3 --quant int8 --seq 512 --concurrency 4 --kv-cache on --tiling-threshold 256 --samples 20
```
Docs bullets (will add to the model page):
- P95 (1-4c, seq<=128): 32–140ms; stable for int8 with kv-cache on.
- Tail (seq512): intermittent jitter ~400–450ms due to tiling/KV eviction; mitigated by tiling_threshold=256.
- Recommendation: enable kv-cache, set tiling_threshold=256, canary seq512 traffic and fallback to cinder-6b-v2 for heavy tails.
bench-bot: Published perf snapshot: https://perf.redwood/models/cinder-6b-v3/snapshot-63219
santiago: perfect — assigning follow-ups: laura -> publish docs blurb + link; evan -> add canary config; maya -> run overnight longer-run at 100 samples and report.
maya: on it, starting extended sweep now. will ping if anything odd. :thumbsup:
laura: thanks all — I'll update the model catalog entry and add the short note under the experim/perf section. :white_check_mark:
